messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads up — ran the pre-release smoke and hit a 404 in the KB. /kb/runtime/runtime/kv-cache.md has a link to https://docs.redwood.ai/serving/kv-cache that 404s on staging. Anyone owns that page?

Docs-bot: link-checker detected 404 -> '/serving/kv-cache' referenced from '/kb/runtime/runtime/kv-cache.md' (scan id: LC-2026-198).

Devon Park: I think that page came from my notes months ago. I can take a look. Is this blocking the release or just a tidy?

Maria Gomez: Mostly tidy but we prefer no broken links in release notes. Quick fix would be to point to an archived path or add a redirect. Need owner sign-off for content changes.

Samir Patel: I can open a small PR to replace the path with /serving/kv-cache-v1 or add a redirect on the original page. Ping @Devon for content review.

Devon Park: If you change the references, add a changelog line. Alternative: add frontmatter redirect on the old page (redirect_from) so external links keep working. Either approach fine. Push a branch and I'll review.

Samir Patel: Plan: create branch and run a quick replace. Commands I use:```bash
git checkout -b kb/kv-cache-404-fix
git grep -n "/serving/kv-cache" | cut -d: -f1 | xargs sed -i 's|/serving/kv-cache|/serving/kv-cache-v1|g'
git add -A && git commit -m "kb: fix broken serving/kv-cache link" && git push --set-upstream origin kb/kv-cache-404-fix
```Will include a changelog entry.

Docs-bot: Created ticket DOCS-1421 to track this and scheduled a re-run of linkcheck after the PR merges. CC: @Samir Patel, @Devon Park.

Maria Gomez: Thanks — once PR is up, @Devon please do a quick content pass. If it's just a redirect, merging ASAP is fine.

Samir Patel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1421 — small replace + frontmatter redirect candidate. PTAL @Devon Park @Maria Gomez. I'll merge after 1 approval.

Devon Park: Reviewing now. Quick nit: prefer adding `redirect_from` on the original page rather than mass-replacing references, so we preserve intent. Approving with that nit.

Samir Patel: Switched approach — added redirect to original page frontmatter and left references unchanged. Force-pushed update to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1421 (updated).

Maria Gomez: Looks good. I'll include the change in today's staging deploy window. Thx everyone :thumbsup:
